title: ARACOVID19-MFH: ARABIC COVID-19 MULTI-LABEL FAKE NEWS AND HATE SPEECH DETECTION DATASET
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure any aspects of faith or religion. It focuses on COVID-19 misinformation, hate speech, and other related categories in Arabic tweets.
findings: There were no findings related to religion, as it was not a subject of the study.
